registry_diagnostic.finding: Turn Aside is one of 45 exact missing Position-1 identities.

rationale: Turn Aside is the smallest current missing Izzet identity that reuses the already-qualified counter path and an already-existing TargetsMatching stack predicate; no shared engine source change is proposed.

oracle.name: Turn Aside
oracle.text: Counter target spell that targets a permanent you control.

required_cases: counter a spell targeting a permanent controlled by Turn Aside's caster
reject a spell targeting only a permanent Turn Aside's caster does not control
reject a spell targeting a player rather than a permanent
snapshot_rule: Regenerate card snapshots and require the only generated file delta to be SOM.json with exactly one new Turn Aside record and no existing record changes.
excluded: whole Position-1 pilot or action ranking
